title: Stochastic Analysis of Fifth-Order KdV Soliton in Damping Regime and Reduction to Painlevé Second Equation
summary: This work presents a stochastic analysis of fifth-order KdV soliton momentum distribution in a damping regime. An explicit representation of the soliton momentum associated with amplitude variation is derived in terms of a random time function in the presence of dissipation. Statistical interpretations of soliton propagation modes, amplitude fluctuations, and amplification are analyzed within a $δ$-correlated Gaussian random framework.
